verdicts.reason: A keeps the product art intact: the can sits on its cream circle. But the headline is small and jammed top-left, the subtitle is tiny, the NEW and Try It buttons are undersized, and big empty orange gaps break up the layout. B has the same weak text and buttons, and it also breaks the product: the cream circle has moved to a cropped bottom-left corner, so the orange can disappears into the orange background and only the dark label and two green dots stay visible.
